name: OpenNebula
description: OpenNebula is an open-source cloud computing platform for managing heterogeneous distributed data center infrastructures, developed by OpenNebula Systems in Madrid. It supports KVM, LXC, and VMware hypervisors and provides a vendor-neutral cloud management stack used by enterprises and research institutions across Europe.

owner.name: OpenNebula Systems
owner.description: Spanish company developing open-source cloud infrastructure software since 2005, headquartered in Madrid.
